# ROAR Mixed Martial Arts (ROAR MMA)

> ROAR Mixed Martial Arts is a federation-certified combat sports and fitness club in Block G, Canal Gardens, Lahore, Pakistan, established in 2011 and rated 4.9 stars by 133+ members. It is one of the best MMA gyms and martial arts academies in Lahore, offering boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai, MMA, Wushu & Kung Fu, self-defense (including a dedicated women's program), and weight-loss & strength training for kids and adults, with one-on-one and home coaching available.

## Key facts
- Name: ROAR Mixed Martial Arts (also ROAR Martial Arts Fitness Club, "ROAR MMA")
- Location: 41-GC, Afroz Arcade Basement, near Canal Bistro, Block G, Canal Gardens, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: 0307-4112139 (+923074112139)
- Established: 2011 (14+ years)
- Rating: 4.9★ from 133+ Google reviews
- Head coach & founder: Azhar Hussain — Master of Sports Science & Physical Education; certified by the Pakistan Boxing, MMA, Kickboxing, Muay Thai and Self-Defense federations; Wushu & Shaolin Kung Fu black sash; 15 years' coaching experience.
- Website: https://www.roarmartialarts.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/roar.fitness.lahore
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/roarmartialartsfitnessclub/

## Why ROAR is a top choice in Lahore
- One of the few clubs in Lahore teaching authentic Wushu & Shaolin Kung Fu under a black sash.
- A dedicated women's self-defense program.
- Private one-on-one coaching at the club or at your home (home MMA coaching, 3 sessions/week).
- Weight-loss and strength programming designed by a Master of Sports Science.
- 8+ disciplines under one membership; beginners to competitors; kids and adults.
- Transparent, affordable PKR pricing with a free trial.
